question: Under whose leadership was the 42ⁿd Amendment Act passed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **42nd Amendment Act:**

 
 
• **​​It was enacted by Indian National Congress headed by Indira Gandhi.** 
 
• Words ‘Socialist’, ‘Secular’ and ‘Integrity’ were added in the Preamble
 
• The 42nd Amendment Act is also known as the ‘Mini-Constitution'.
 
• 10 Fundamental Duties were added for the citizens after the 42nd Amendment Act
 
• It also made President bound to the advice of the cabinet.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Prime Minister**
 **About**
 
 

 Indira Gandhi
 
 
 
• Indira Gandhi was India's **third prime minister,** serving from 1966 until 1984 when her life ended in assassination.
 
• She was the **first and only female** Prime Minister of India.
 
 
 
 

 Morarji Desai
 
 
 
• Morarji Desai was the **5th Prime Minister of India.**
 
• He was the 2nd Deputy Prime Minister of India.
 
 
 
 

 Rajiv Gandhi
 
 
 
• At the age of 40 years, Mr. Rajiv Gandhi was the youngest Prime Minister of India.
 
• He was the** 6th Prime Minister of India**.
 
• He was perhaps even one of the youngest elected heads of Government in the world at that time.
 
• He was third generation Prime Minister from his family.
 
 
 
 

 Charan Singh
 
 
 
• Chaudhary Charan Singh served as the 7th Prime Minister of India.
 
• His tenure was from 28 July 1979 to 14 January 1980.
 
• He is often referred to as the "Champion of India's peasants".
 
• He belonged to the Janta Party (secular) and has also served as the Finance Minister and Home Minister in the Morarji Desai's Govt.
 
• His Birthday, on 23 December is celebrated as Kisan Diwas in India.
